title: Europe's Hera Reaches the Asteroid NASA Smashed in December

scenes.text: NASA smashed a spacecraft into an asteroid.
It hit a tiny moon called Dimorphos, about seven million miles from Earth.
The crash shortened its orbit by more than half an hour.
This December, Europe's Hera spacecraft arrives to inspect the damage.
It will measure the crater, and the asteroid's pull, for the first time.
So the asteroid we hit finally gets a crash report.

description:
NASA smashed a spacecraft into an asteroid, and this December Europe's Hera spacecraft arrives to inspect the damage.
The 2022 crash shortened the orbit of the moonlet Dimorphos by more than half an hour, and Hera will measure the crater it left.
Would you want to see the crater up close? Comment below.
first_comment: NASA hit it, Europe inspects it. Should every asteroid we might need to deflect get its own follow-up mission?
